sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/16 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/place for PlaceId 16 and search/grid for campgrounds A-G, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/kiptopeke ('EW - Electric/water sites; various equipment. Accepts outlets 20, 30 and 50-amp current'; 'EWS - Electric/water and sewer sites ... accepts outlets 20, 30 and 50-amp current'; 'Sewer is only available on sites B- 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, and all campsites in C Loop'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DCR: 'Total campsites : 138' (Tent Std 52, EW 66, EWS 27, plus 4 yurts; the parts add to more than the total). The booking site lists 93 RV sites: loop A 42 electric/water, loop B 24 electric/water + 7 with sewer, loop C 20 with sewer; loops D-G are 52 tent-only sites. DCR gives 'RVs up to 40 ft' for the sewer sites; the booking site's per-site vehicle lengths (20-70 ft) look like pad lengths and were not used. One wheeled camping unit plus one tent, or two tents, per RV site.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/kiptopeke ('Total sites of each site type : Tent Std, 52; EW, 66; EWS (E/W/Sewer), 27; Deluxe Yurt, 1; Std Yurt, 3', 'Total campsites : 138', 'RV campsites allow one wheeled camping unit and one tent or two tents') + reservevaparks.com search/grid for facilities 91-97, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two campground bathhouses with hot showers and coin-operated washers and dryers; camp store open Wednesday-Sunday 9-5 (firewood sold there; outside firewood not allowed).

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/kiptopeke ('The full-service campground offers sites with water and electric (some sites have sewer hookups), hot showers and restrooms', 'Each bathhouse in the campground has coin-operated washers and dryers', 'Camp Store is open Wednesday-Sunday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All campsites are now site-specific.' Reserve online or at 1-800-933-PARK. Campers parking a boat trailer at the boat launch instead of their site pay an extra fee ($3).

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/kiptopeke ('All campsites are now site-specific', 'reserve online or call 1-800-933-PARK', boat-trailer parking), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the season (first Friday in March to first Monday in December, already manual) and reservable by specific site; fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12. Added 50-amp electric with water, sewer on some B sites and all of loop C, 138 sites (93 for RVs on the booking site), showers/laundry/camp store. Not stated: dump station, pull-throughs, one max-rig figure for all RV sites, booking window/cutoff for this park (left inherited), fcfs.
flags: Missing operator website: DCR's park page https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/kiptopeke (the entry's website is only the booking site).
